subject: Dragon Eggs
text: This guide lists the locations of all 12 eggs.

evidence.quote: So, I will list the locations of all 12 eggs

subject: Egg Guy
text: An Egg Guy can be located by its Nah, Nah, Na-Na-Nah cry, and it is nearby when you hear it.

evidence.quote: You can tell one is near by their "Nah, Nah, Na-Na-Nah" cry

subject: Egg Guy
requires: Charge with Spyro
text: Egg Guys run when approached, so charge them with Spyro and flame them when they are within range.

evidence.quote: Charge them with Spyro and when they are within ... range: flame them.

subject: Dragon Eggs
text: All 12 eggs can be found in the first half of the game.

evidence.quote: There are 12 eggs and all can be found in the first half of the game.

subject: Dragon Egg 1
text: Dragon Egg 1 is held by the Egg Guy in Stone Hill.

evidence.quote: Chase the Egg Guy ... down to retrieve your first egg.

subject: Stone Hill cave
text: From the start, head into the cave on the right and go through it to reach a second grass area.

evidence.quote: head into the cave on the right and process through

subject: Stone Hill tower
text: Ride the air current in the tower ahead up to the top.

evidence.quote: Go into the tower ahead and ride the ... air current up to the top.

subject: Stone Hill
requires: Face the direction of the cave you entered from
text: Glide to the grassy top above the cave entrance, facing the direction you entered from.

evidence.quote: Glide to the grassy top above the cave entrance.

subject: Town Square elevated ledge
requires: Face the way you came from the Alvar dragon
text: An elevated ledge on the right side of Town Square can be jumped onto to glide out over the steps.

evidence.quote: There is an elevated ledge on the right side.

subject: Town Square
requires: Hug the right wall
text: Hugging the right wall reaches a grassy ledge around the corner.

evidence.quote: and you'll reach a grassy ledge around the corner.

subject: Cannon by Doctor Shemp gate
requires: Flame the cannon at the rock with the red target
text: Flaming the cannon at the red-targeted rock fires a cannonball that reveals a platform where the rock was.

evidence.quote: The resulting cannonball will reveal a ... platform where the rock once was.

subject: Peace Keepers Home
requires: Glide over the gap from the platform
text: From the revealed platform, glide over the gap to the desert area in the distance.

evidence.quote: glide over to the desert area

subject: Dragon Egg 3
requires: Reach the desert area
text: Dragon Egg 3 is held by the third Egg Guy in an alcove in the desert area.

evidence.quote: An alcove here has the third egg guy.

subject: Dragon Egg 4
requires: Cross the bridge into the second part of town
text: Dragon Egg 4 is held by the Egg Guy in the second part of Cliff Town after crossing the bridge.

evidence.quote: Once you head over the bridge into the second part of town, the egg guy will ... Just chase him down.

subject: Dry Canyon
text: A narrow path on the left side beside a purple goop ditch leads to an alcove from the start.

evidence.quote: there's a narrow path on the left side beside a purple

subject: Dragon Egg 5
text: Dragon Egg 5 is held by the Blue Egg Guy hiding in an alcove in Dry Canyon.

evidence.quote: Go in to find the Blue Egg Guy hiding in an alcove.

subject: Dragon Egg 6
requires: Go inside the blue tunnel ahead from the Ballonist drop-off
text: Dragon Egg 6 is held by a blue Egg Guy waiting at a junction inside the blue tunnel.

evidence.quote: see this blue guy waiting for you at a junction.

subject: Blue Egg Guy at junction
requires: Charge and cut corners to flame him right away
text: The blue Egg Guy at the junction jumps to an unreachable ledge if he is not flamed right away.

evidence.quote: he'll jump up to a ledge making him unreachable.

subject: Blue Egg Guy at junction
requires: Face away from the spawn point
text: Facing away from where the Egg Guy spawns makes him respawn at the junction.

evidence.quote: Face away from where he spawns to ... make him re-spawn

subject: Dragon Egg 7
requires: Pass through the tunnel and chamber
text: Dragon Egg 7 is held by the second blue Egg Guy at the very top level of the section, up the ramps.

evidence.quote: is the second blue egg guy.

subject: Magic Crafters Home tunnel
requires: Pass the first blue Egg Guy in the tunnel
text: Going through the tunnel with the first blue Egg Guy and past the chamber leads outside again.

evidence.quote: After heading through the tunnel with the first blue egg guy

subject: High Caves supercharge gap
requires: Supercharge the gap
text: Supercharge the gap, then take a hard right while airborne and aim for the grassy field in the distance.

evidence.quote: When you go to supercharge the gap ... take a hard right as you get airborne and

subject: Dragon Egg 8
requires: Reach the grassy field after supercharge
text: Dragon Egg 8 is held by the blue Egg Guy on the grassy field at the top of the ramp.

evidence.quote: The blue egg guy is on this field

subject: High Caves bridge
requires: Pass the cave with the supercharge ramp
text: Past the cave with the supercharge ramp, a bridge leads to another chamber.

evidence.quote: Past the cave with the supercharge ramp is a bridge leading to another chamber.

subject: High Caves bridge
requires: Stand at mid section of bridge facing right
text: From the middle of the bridge facing right, glide to the nearest ledge, then glide to the second one.

evidence.quote: Glide to the nearest one, then glide to the ... second one to find the blue egg guy inside.

subject: Dragon Egg 9
requires: Glide to the second ledge chamber
text: Dragon Egg 9 is held by the blue Egg Guy inside the second ledge chamber off the bridge.

evidence.quote: second one to find the blue egg guy inside.

subject: Wizard Peak
requires: Use the second supercharge ramp
text: From the second supercharge ramp, go down and then up the ramp, then jump to glide to the island ahead.

evidence.quote: When you get to the second supercharge ramp, go down and then up the ramp ... At the top, quickly jump to glide to the island ahead.

subject: Dragon Egg 10
requires: Glide to the island ahead
text: Dragon Egg 10 is held by the Egg Guy behind the wall on the island.

evidence.quote: Egg 10 ... here is the Egg Guy.

subject: Dragon Egg 10 island
requires: Work carefully behind the wall
text: Work carefully behind the wall without falling, then flame the Egg Guy.

evidence.quote: Carefully work your way behind there, be careful not to ... fall, and flame him.

subject: Dragon Egg 11
requires: Reach the pool near the Return Home Pad
text: Dragon Egg 11 is held by the Egg Guy around the pool in the same area as the Return Home Pad.

evidence.quote: Egg 11 ... He is around the pool in the same area as Lucas dragon

subject: Dragon Egg 11 pool
requires: Jump across the pool itself
text: Jump across the pool itself and flame the Egg Guy to get the egg.

evidence.quote: Just jump across the pool itself and flame him to get this Egg.

subject: Alpine Ridge
requires: Stand at the Return Home pad
text: From the Return Home pad, face the open area and glide to the cave entrance on the right of the firework-box ledges.

evidence.quote: When you get to the Return Home pad, face out into the big open area that you ... To the right of those is a cave entrance, glide there.

subject: Dragon Egg 12
requires: Chase down the final egg thief
text: Egg 12 is retrieved by chasing down and flaming the final egg thief.

evidence.quote: Egg 12 ... Just chase him down and flame him to retrive this final egg.

subject: Egg Guy
requires: Flame the Egg Guy within range
text: The egg will then drop and Spyro will proceed to pick it up after flaming the egg thief within range.

evidence.quote: range: flame them.  The egg will then drop and Spyro will proceed to pick it

subject: Dragon Egg 2
requires: Reach the Alvar dragon
text: In Town Square, you will then see the egg guy up here: chase him down to get Dragon Egg 2.

evidence.quote: You will then see the ... egg guy up here: chase him down.

subject: Dragon Egg 12
requires: Glide to the cave entrance to the right of the firework-box ledges
text: Dragon Egg 12 is held by the final egg thief in Alpine Ridge.

evidence.quote: Egg 12 ... You'll find the final egg thief in here.
